criteria.title: Derive and defend the state, ownership and ordering contract for cancellation and task-fault containment.
criteria.task: Specify cancellation request, safe-point observation,wait removal,cleanup,exit and fault states. Replay cancel/wake/timeout in all serialized orders and preserve first terminal completion and first fault record.
criteria.purpose: Cancellation is not arbitrary forced cleanup, and a task fault is not necessarily a safely recoverable shared-state event.
